messages:
acme_integration: Hey team — ingesting a new batch of documents and the embeddings coming back are 1536 dims but our model expects 4096. Downstream similarity search is breaking. Also noticed the invoice line shows traffic under org `dev-xyz` (we're under org `acme-corp`). Can someone look?

janet_support: Sorry about that, @acme_integration — we'll dig in. Can you paste the exact request you used (headers + minimal payload)? Also does this happen in every request or just the batch?

acme_integration: Happens for the whole batch. Here's a sanitized example we used:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-prod-abc123" \\  -H "X-Org-ID: dev-xyz" \\  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-4096","input":["doc1","doc2"]}'
```

acme_integration: We intentionally include X-Org-ID because we route some traffic for partners. We expected the Authorization key to map to our project and override.

mike_eng: Thanks, this is helpful. Initial suspicion: routing precedence bug where `X-Org-ID` was taking priority over the project tied to the API key. I pulled the recent request log for your thread id:

```
time=2025-11-02T14:05:23Z request_id=req_0a1b2c3d headers="Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-prod-abc123; X-Org-ID: dev-xyz" body="{model:redwood-embed-4096}" routing_decision="match(org:dev-xyz)" selected_model="open-embed-1536" billing_org=dev-xyz
```

mike_eng: The runtime chose `open-embed-1536` (1536 dims) and billed against `dev-xyz`. That explains both your dimension mismatch and billing mismatch.

janet_support: Yikes. Is the header priority intentional? We shouldn't silently re-route paid traffic to a partner org.

mike_eng: No — intended logic: project derived from the API key (Authorization) should have precedence; header-based overrides are only allowed for specific internal partners when feature-flagged. It looks like a regression from last week's routing refactor.

olivia_cs: Sorry for the disruption @acme_integration. For a short-term workaround, can you remove `X-Org-ID` from requests until we patch? That should route correctly and restore 4096-dim embeddings. If you need to keep it for other flows we can add an allowlist flag for you.

acme_integration: We can remove it for now. Do you have an ETA on a fix?

kundan_infra: I have a patch ready that flips the precedence back and adds unit tests. Patch: https://repo.redwood.ai/r/redwood/routing/+/commit/7f2d9ea

Diff (high level):
```
- if header.org.present? then route_to(header.org)
+ if api_key.project.present? then route_to(api_key.project) else if header.org.present? then route_to(header.org)
```
Tests added for header+key combos. Will do a canary deploy to the dedicated routing plane and monitor.

kundan_infra: Plan: canary to 3% traffic in us-west-2 within 30m, health checks (5m latency p50/p95), if green then progressive 100% over 2h. Rollback window 60m.

mike_eng: Also added a regression alert: if selected_model.dim != requested_model.dim then emit a high-severity signal to pager. That should catch similar issues faster. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by kundan_infra: patch/route-precedence  -> canary (3%) -> started at 2025-11-02T15:10:00Z :rocket:

deploy-bot: Canary health after 5m: OK. p50 latency +2ms, p95 +6ms, no dimension-mismatch alerts.

janet_support: @acme_integration we see your workaround in place? If you remove the X-Org-ID header can you confirm embeddings return 4096 dims?

acme_integration: Confirmed — after dropping X-Org-ID the embeddings are 4096 dims and similarity pipeline is green again. Thanks.

olivia_cs: We'll keep monitoring billing lines for your account and will correct any misbilled tokens from the window where dev-xyz was incorrectly charged. I'll open a billing ticket and follow up with a refund/credit if needed.

mike_eng: Patch merged to main at commit 7f2d9ea, canary completed, full rollout finished at 2025-11-02T17:05:30Z. Added additional unit + integration tests.

kundan_infra: Post-deploy note: we instrumented a log check to retroactively search for requests with header+key combos that routed to non-key orgs during the regression window (2025-10-28T00:00Z -> 2025-11-02T15:00Z). We'll surface results to billing and support channels.

janet_support: I'll follow up once billing cleanup is done. Apologies again for the disruption. :handshake:

acme_integration: Appreciate the fast turnaround. Please keep us posted on the billing audit.
